messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 — inference-us-west: sustained 5xx spike + tail latency >2s across multiple pods. Pager routed to oncall. Details: https://pager.redwood.internal/alerts/1797502468 :rotating_light:

emma: ack — I'm oncall, joining war room. war room link: https://meet.redwood/warroom/1797502468 — assigning ownership to myself for initial triage.

raj: joining. will run the runbook quick checks (connectivity, pod restarts, recent deploys). can anyone confirm last deploys in us-west?

luis: seeing customer error reports from 3 hosted customers in us-west region (API 503/timeouts). embeddings endpoints look fine so far. no alerts from infra control plane.

emma: quick blast radius: routed traffic to eu-west canary, starting traffic steering for non-logged customers -> fallback region. posting a status page draft in a sec.

carla: prepping status page copy now. draft: "We are investigating increased error rates and elevated latency for Redwood Inference in the US-West region. Some API requests may return 503 or experience timeouts. Our engineers are actively mitigating. We will provide updates in 15 minutes."

emma: status draft looks good @carla, please post to status.redwood.com and ping #customer-comms once live. tag @support for proactive customer outreach.

raj: running quick remediation: restarting affected inference deployment set. command: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-us-west -n redwood-serving```

deploy-bot: rollout restart initiated for deployment/inference-us-west (uid: deploy-1797). watching rollout status.

raj: rollout finished on 4/5 pods — one pod failing CrashLoopBackoff (oom). evicting & recreating that pod now.

emma: noted. I've opened a ticket for pod oom investigation (INC-179750). continuing to monitor traffic and error rate.

deploy-bot: rollout completed, all pods updated (except recreated pod).

raj: error rate dropped ~60% after restart, tail latency improved but still ~1.2s 95th. investigating KV cache pressure and model shard placement.

emma: good improvement. keeping war room open. next customer-facing update in 15m unless we have full mitigation. I'll update status page with current signal.

carla: posted status page and notified #customer-comms. copy: "Mitigation in progress; error rates reduced after service restart. Some customers may still see intermittent errors. Engineers remain engaged."

luis: thanks team. flagging Premium customers that had errors — @support will follow up with direct outreach once we have full RCA.

emma: thanks. assigning post-incident owner for RCA: raj. will hand off owner after we stabilize.

raj: acknowledged. I'll take RCA and start log collection / profiling traces. saving warp room recordings and timeline.

emma: oncall handoff note: if this is still active at handoff, escalate to oncall+1. Otherwise I'll perform normal postmortem process.

carla: reacted :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-1797502468, war room link pinned.

emma: closing this kickoff thread; ongoing updates will be in the war room channel. thanks all for rapid responses.
